description:
RFC 0044 Phase 8 report I/O: ConformanceReportWriter serializes an
        assembled ConformanceRun to files via the generated Java codec (one
        summary + one file per module), and ConformanceReportSource reads them
        back, mapping a module result by class id. Depends on the engine (to
        assemble) and the output-only report-codec (to serialize). The studio
        runs the export at build and reads via the source at runtime.
